Perfect. Before I build your **comparison sales sheet + demo script**, can you confirm a few quick details so I can tailor it to your exact offer?  

Please answer these 5 short questions:  

1. 💼 **Your version of Go High Level:**  
Do you sell it as a **white-labeled CRM under your brand** (ex: “Fully Booked CRM” or “Acquisity CRM”), or do you present it as “Go High Level”?  

2. 🎯 **Target audience:**  
Are you pitching this specifically to **med spa owners**, or also to **other verticals** like plastic surgery, wellness, or functional medicine?  

3. 💰 **Pricing structure:**  
What do you typically charge monthly (or setup + monthly)? Example:  
- $297/month DIY  
- $497/month done-for-you  
- $997/month with marketing automations  

4. 🔧 **Feature focus:**  
Which 3–5 features are your biggest selling points? (Examples: 2-way texting, pipeline tracking, automations, lead attribution, AI follow-ups, etc.)  

5. 📞 **Sales format:**  
Do you want this sheet and script designed for **live sales calls**, **email/DM pitches**, or **PDF/slide deck presentation**?  

Once you give me these, I’ll create:  
✅ A polished **comparison sales sheet** (Go High Level vs Aesthetic RX vs Podium vs Boulevard)  
✅ A **demo script + objection-handling guide** tailored to your pricing, audience, and brand tone  

This will make you sound like the category leader when pitching.

Here’s how to *pitch and position* your Go High Level (GHL) CRM as clearly superior to **Aesthetic RX, Podium, or Boulevard**—even without invoking “The Aesthetic Edge” brand.  

---

## 1. The Core Positioning Statement
> “Our CRM isn’t just a communication tool or scheduling app—it’s the **entire operating system** for your Med Spa. While Podium, Aesthetic RX, and Boulevard each handle one piece of the puzzle, Go High Level runs the entire business on one platform.”

---

## 2. Understand Their Current Pain
Each of those platforms fills only *one slice* of the workflow pie:
| Platform | Core Function | Common Pain Points |
|-----------|----------------|--------------------|
| **Aesthetic RX** | EMR + charting | Expensive per provider, weak marketing automation, limited patient reactivation, poor customization |
| **Boulevard** | Booking + POS | Great UI but lacks 2-way automation, limited segmentation, not built for outbound marketing or retention funnels |
| **Podium** | Reviews + text | Doesn’t manage scheduling, no funnel builder, no automation beyond SMS follow-ups |

So your discovery questions should be:
- “How are you tracking your leads from Facebook or Google Ads all the way to paid service?”
- “When a lead doesn’t book, how many automations do you have in place to nurture them?”
- “Do you know your real conversion rate from first message to paid service?”

These usually surface where GHL can 10x their performance.

---

## 3. Core Differentiators to Emphasize
### 🚀 **1. All-In-One Ecosystem**
- **Replace 6–8 subscriptions** (Podium, Mailchimp, Calendly, CallRail, Zapier, ClickFunnels, etc.).
- Includes **unlimited users, texts, emails, funnels, automations, forms, and reviews** under one dashboard.

### 💬 **2. End-to-End Lead Journey Tracking**
- Track every client from *ad click → first message → consult → sale → rebook*.
- See which source produces the highest ROI—something Podium and Boulevard cannot do.

### ⚙️ **3. Automation That Closes the Gap**
- When someone fills out a form → instant 2-way text → nurture sequence → auto booking link.
- You can build *smart workflows* like:
  - “If no response in 1 hour → follow-up text.”
  - “If no-show → send reschedule + reactivation offer.”

### 💰 **4. Built-In Revenue Tools**
- **Pipeline dashboards** that show daily revenue goals.
- **Membership + package management** to track recurring revenue.
- **Review automation + referral triggers** built right into the funnel.

### 🎯 **5. Fully White-Labeled**
- You can brand it as your own med spa app—clients book, pay, and text through your system.
- For growth partners, this builds brand authority and retention.

---

## 4. The “ROI Argument” (The Killer Close)
> “You’re already paying $700–$1,200/month across 3–4 tools that don’t talk to each other.  
With GHL, you pay less, get more automation, and have visibility across your entire funnel.”

You can even show the **math**:
- Podium: $399/month  
- Boulevard: $275–$500/month  
- Aesthetic RX: $450–$600/month per provider  
- Total: $1,100–$1,500/month  
**vs. GHL: $297–$497/month fully loaded**

> “So for the cost of one partial system, you can have the whole tech stack and save $10K+ per year.”

---

## 5. Emotional Angle (The “Control and Clarity” Hook)
> “Most med spa owners feel like they’re running 5 different platforms that never sync.  
Go High Level gives you full control—every lead, message, and dollar in one dashboard.  
No more guessing, no more ‘where did that lead come from?’ moments.”

Tie it to **freedom and peace of mind**, not just features.

---

## 6. Optional Add-On (If You Want to Upsell the Edge Later)
Even without “The Aesthetic Edge,” you can close with:
> “We’ve customized this version specifically for aesthetics, so you’re not getting a generic GHL template. You’re getting pre-built funnels, nurture automations, and metrics aligned with consult-to-booking flow.”

Later, when you reintroduce *The Aesthetic Edge*, it feels like the “pro” version—an easy upgrade.

---

## 7. Short Power Pitch (For Calls or Cold DMs)
> “Hey [Name], I noticed you’re using [Aesthetic RX/Boulevard/Podium].  
Quick question—how are you tracking which marketing sources actually convert to revenue?  
Most of our clients switched because those platforms don’t connect the dots.  
Our system replaces 5+ tools, automates your lead follow-ups, and shows you the ROI of every ad in real time.  
Would you be open to a quick demo to see how it stacks up against what you’re using?”

---

Would you like me to create a **ready-to-use comparison sales sheet or demo script** (one column per platform with talking points and objection handling)? It makes closing these CRM conversions much easier.

How do you pitch someone on buying your Go-High-Level CRM when they've been using Aesthetic RX, Podium, or Boulevard? How do you convince them that Go-High-Level is ten times better even without the Aesthetic Edge?

Got it — you want a **functionality-driven pitch and comparison** between **Go High Level (GHL)** and **Aesthetic RX**, not price-based.  

Here’s how to frame it when pitching and demoing:

---

## 🧩 Core Positioning Statement
> “Aesthetic RX is a solid clinical EMR built for charting and compliance. Go High Level is a business-growth engine built for lead capture, conversion, retention, and client communication.  
> Most clinics use Aesthetic RX to *document what happened.*  
> Go High Level helps them *create what happens next.*”

---

## 🔍 Functional Comparison

| **Category** | **Aesthetic RX** | **Go High Level (Your CRM)** | **Talking Point / Pitch Line** |
|---------------|------------------|-------------------------------|--------------------------------|
| **Purpose** | Clinical EMR for charting, prescriptions, and patient records | Marketing + sales automation platform for acquisition, communication, and retention | “Aesthetic RX manages the treatment. Go High Level manages the relationship.” |
| **Lead Capture** | Limited web form integration, mostly manual entry | Customizable funnels, web forms, and landing pages auto-sync to CRM | “Every inquiry is instantly captured, tagged, and followed up on — no more leads lost in email.” |
| **2-Way Communication** | One-way reminders via email/SMS | Unified texting, calling, voicemail drops, and social DMs in one inbox | “All conversations — Facebook, IG, Google, SMS — live in one thread.” |
| **Follow-Up Automation** | Manual or static reminders | Smart workflows (missed call text-backs, drip nurture, reactivation) | “If someone doesn’t book, the system automatically keeps the conversation alive.” |
| **Pipeline Visibility** | No sales pipeline view | Visual pipeline for every stage (new lead, consult, booked, paid, follow-up) | “You can see your business heartbeat at a glance — where each lead stands and what revenue it represents.” |
| **Reporting + Attribution** | Basic reports, no marketing source tracking | Tracks source, campaign, and revenue attribution for every lead | “You’ll finally know which ads and offers actually convert.” |
| **Client Retention** | Manual outreach | Automated review requests, birthday offers, re-engagement campaigns | “No more dormant clients — the system brings them back automatically.” |
| **Online Booking** | Solid scheduler tied to charting | Booking links that trigger automations, tags, and reminders | “When someone books, it doesn’t just block time — it starts a full journey.” |
| **Integrations** | Mostly internal, limited external marketing integrations | Connects to FB Ads, Google Ads, IG DMs, email, Stripe, and more | “One command center that connects marketing, sales, and service.” |
| **Customization** | Locked templates, clinic-focused UI | Fully customizable pipelines, tags, automations, and dashboards | “You control your process — not the other way around.” |

---

## 💬 Elevator Pitch for a Call or Demo
> “You’ll still need Aesthetic RX for your medical charting, but it’s not built to grow your client base or automate your front desk.  
> Go High Level handles every step before and after the appointment — from ad click to five-star review — giving you total visibility and control over your business flow.  
> Think of it as the missing half of your clinic: Aesthetic RX handles compliance; our CRM drives conversion.”

---

## 🎯 Demo Flow (What to Show)
1. **Dashboard Overview:** Show the live pipeline — how leads move from “New Inquiry” to “Paid.”  
2. **Smart Automations:** Demonstrate an SMS workflow that texts back after a missed call.  
3. **Unified Inbox:** Display all conversations in one screen (texts, IG, FB, Google).  
4. **Attribution Reports:** Show which marketing source drove each booked consult.  
5. **Reactivation Sequence:** Pull up a 90-day dormant list → send an automated campaign → show expected revenue lift.

---

## 🛠 Suggested Close Line
> “Aesthetic RX keeps you compliant. Go High Level keeps you competitive. Together, they complete your business — but without Go High Level, you’re leaving opportunity on the table.”

---

Would you like me to now format this into a **one-page visual comparison sheet** (something you can send or show in a demo, with clear icons and branding areas)?
